sections.title: باب 7 — متن (37)

paras.text: When the batsman’s bat, the ball, or some part of the body touches the wickets or knocks down the bails, the player will be considered out. The fielding player can use his hand or arm to knock down the wicket provided that the one doing so has the ball in his hand. Besides this the batsman is out in the following ways.

paras.pashto: کله چې د بیټسمن بیټ، توپ یا د بدن کومه برخه ویکټونه ولمسوي یا بیلز وغورځوي، لوبغاړی اوټ ګڼل کېږي. فیلډر کولی شي خپل لاس یا مټ د ویکټ غورځولو لپاره وکاروي، په دې شرط چې توپ یې په لاس کې وي. سربېره پر دې بیټسمن په لاندې طریقو اوټ کېږي.

paras.text: If some batsman during the game touches the ball with his hands, or catches the ball thrown by a fielder, or hits it with the bat, then the player is declared out; but if the batsman did so at the request of the opposing team, he will not be out. sections.theory:
Batsman being out

When the batsman’s bat, the ball, or some part of the body touches the wickets or knocks down the bails, the player will be considered out. The fielding player can use his hand or arm to knock down the wicket provided that the one doing so has the ball in his hand. Besides this the batsman is out in the following ways.

i. Leaving the crease

The batsman fails in the attempt to play the ball and the wicket keeper, catching the ball, hits the wickets. If during this the batsman is outside the crease, he becomes out. This is also called stumped out.

ii. Bowled

While playing the ball, the ball touches the wickets, or touching the batsman’s body comes and strikes the wickets, then the batsman becomes out. Being out in this way is called “bowled”.

iii. Catch out

When the ball played by some batsman is caught by a fielding player before touching the ground, the batsman becomes catch out, provided this catch is taken inside the boundary.

iv. Batsman catching the ball

If some batsman during the game touches the ball with his hands, or catches the ball thrown by a fielder, or hits it with the bat, then the player is declared out; but if the batsman did so at the request of the opposing team, he will not be out. The credit of this wicket will not go to the bowler.

اگر کوئی بیٹسمین کھیل کے دوران گیند کو اپنے ہاتھوں سے چھو لیتا ہے یا فیلڈر کی تھروی ہوئی گیند کو پکڑ لیتا ہے یا بیٹ مار دیتا ہے تو کھلاڑی آؤٹ قرار دے دیا جاتا ہے لیکن بیٹسمین نے مخالف ٹیم کے کہنے پر اگر ایسا کیا ہو تو آؤٹ نہیں ہوگا۔ اس وکٹ کا اعزاز باؤلر کو نہیں ملے گا۔
